formula: compliant eligible answers / (compliant + non_compliant); exclude na, unknown, incomplete
denominator_rule: compliant + non_compliant eligible answers in scope
note: Uses the canonical countChecklistCompliance. Value = Compliant/(C+NC) per the metric title and worked example. Excel formula TEXT ('non-compliant / total') contradicts its own example; recorded as a stop-line decision.

formula: distinct eligible factories grouped by current governed Health Score band
denominator_rule: all eligible factories with a current governed Health Score band
note: This measure is governed by Health Score band. No Health Score snapshot/history source exists; factories.risk_score/risk_band belongs to the separate Risk Engine and is not substituted.

title_en: Violation trend by regulation and severity
formula: count official violations by governed issue date, grouped by period, regulation and severity
note: By-regulation grouping is computable, but violations has NO issue-time column. Time-series-by-official-issue-time cannot be produced without silently substituting submission time, which is prohibited. Severity vocab (L1/L2 vs medium) is also unnormalized.

formula: latest decided Level-2 outcome per submitted inspection, grouped Approve/Return/Reject
denominator_rule: all latest decided Level-2 outcomes in scope
note: Latest review per inspection only. This is a decision mix and is NOT compliance — kept strictly separate from STR-KPI-001.

formula: distinct eligible factory licences by expiry state as of reporting date (Asia/Riyadh)
note: The live industrial_licenses source is confirmed. The governed expiring-soon lead days remain an unconfigured Admin policy, so expired-only data is not substituted for this combined metric.

formula: cancelled visits / total planned visits whose planning window is in the selected period
denominator_rule: all planned visit records whose planning window is in the selected period
note: Computed from visits.planning_status and window_start. The source workbook governs no narrower denominator status set.

formula: distinct due factories with a qualifying completion / distinct factories due under the published inspection-cycle policy
denominator_rule: distinct factories due under the published inspection-cycle policy
note: No inspection-cycle / eligibility / due-date policy table exists. Returns 'Not configured' until a governed cycle policy is published via ADM-DASH-005.

title_en: Uninspected factories by stage, sector and region
formula: classify each eligible factory Never inspected / Due / Overdue / Covered using the published cycle policy
denominator_rule: all eligible factories in the selected grouping
note: Shares the single inspection-cycle/eligibility policy with STR-KPI-007. Not computable until that policy is published.

formula: count distinct effective published inspection items grouped by the issuing authority of their linked regulation
note: Counts each active global inspection_items record once and groups it by its published regulation's issuing_authority. Package reuse does not duplicate the global item.

formula: per stored current risk band: total visits in the selected period / distinct factories currently in that band
denominator_rule: distinct factories carrying the stored current risk band
note: This measure is governed as a band comparison, not a threshold or composite score. Uses the stored current factories.risk_band and exposes the numerator and denominator per band; no mismatch threshold is invented.

formula: distinct factories where the same checklist item failed 2+ times within 12 months / distinct factories with >= 1 official violation
note: This measure is governed as the same checklist item failing 2+ times within 12 months. Stable item-version lineage and an official violation issue date are not available, so no substitute identity or date is used.

formula: 3-5 ranked findings across strategic KPIs, one traceable sentence each, every sentence citing underlying records; advisory only
note: AI sub-capability (Phase 2 note defers the AI generation only). Requires ADM-DASH-011 source/evidence policy to be enabled and every claim linkable to evidence_refs. Disabled until configured.

formula: as-of count of distinct visits grouped exactly by Draft, Published, Returned, and Cancelled planning status
note: Planning status and operational state stay separate; other planning statuses are excluded from this workbook-defined pipeline.

formula: published, not-started visits with window_end within the configured lead time from now
note: The expiring-soon lead time is an SLA/urgency policy parameter (ADM-DASH-007) and must not be hard-coded (48h in the workbook is illustrative). Overdue (window_end < now) is available; the lead-time window is not.

formula: distinct visits in operational_state on_the_way/arrived/executing with inspection not submitted
note: Journey and inspection states reconciled in the shared projection.

formula: submitted inspections with no Level 2 decision
note: Includes submitted inspections without a review row and reviews without a decision. Aging bands require an SLA policy (ADM-DASH-007); base count is live.

formula: count draft configuration objects by object type and owning admin role
note: Admin-only widget. Requires aggregating draft counts across config engines (compliance requests, packages, dashboard config). Definition seeded; projection wiring is a follow-on once the object-type set is confirmed.

formula: count eligible visits whose execution window starts today (Asia/Riyadh), grouped by assigned inspector
note: No overloaded/underloaded judgement is applied unless a capacity policy is published.

formula: count governed override events recorded today (Asia/Riyadh) for out-of-geofence arrival confirmation
note: Official/planner/observed coordinates remain separate; overrides are auditable and never rewrite the official pin.

formula: latest permission-visible immutable audit/timeline events ordered by occurred_at desc
note: Events come from immutable audit data; no fabricated narrative.

formula: 3-5 deterministic-trigger nudges ranked by deadline proximity; each opens a pre-filtered CTA and never executes the action
note: Requires ADM-DASH-012 nudge trigger/CTA policy. Disabled until configured.

formula: count visits within the signed-in inspector's access that are assigned to them and whose execution window starts today (Asia/Riyadh)
note: Only the logged-in inspector's own assignments are included.

formula: today's assigned visits minus visits whose inspector execution is complete (submitted)
note: Completion uses the governed field submitted state, NOT Level-2 approval (which is outside inspector control). Sponsor may override via documented decision.

formula: own current returned inspections + resumable drafts + unsent sync-queue items, without double counting
note: Server-side buckets (returned + resumable draft) computed here; the offline sync-queue count is contributed by the device and merged without double counting.

formula: submitted own visits today / today's assigned visits (x100)
note: Shows N/A when there are no visits; never divides by zero.

formula: latest Level-2 decision per own submitted inspection, grouped Approve/Return/Reject
note: Correctly NAMED as approval outcomes — this fixes the P0 defect where the iPad mislabelled approvals as 'Compliance rate'. Approval is not compliance.

formula: compliant eligible answers / (compliant + non_compliant) over own inspections; exclude na, unknown, incomplete
note: Uses the SAME canonical countChecklistCompliance as STR-KPI-001. This is the correctly-calculated inspector compliance the workbook requires.

formula: own submitted-visit and compliance series over trailing configured periods
note: Trailing-period trend series; definition seeded. Projection wiring is a follow-on once the trailing-period parameter is confirmed (ADM-DASH-002).
